materialProbe.waitSpindle: Wait for the spindle to stop.
materialProbe.waitAxes: Wait for the axes to stop.
materialProbe.touchOffZTop: Touch off {tool} at the tool setter before probing Z.
materialProbe.touchOffCorner: Touch off {tool} and probe Z top before probing a corner.
materialProbe.touchOffBoss: Touch off {tool} and probe Z top on the boss first.
materialProbe.touchOffRidge: Touch off {tool} and probe Z top on the ridge first.
materialProbe.touchOffGauge: Touch off {tool} and probe Z top on the gauge first.

cornerTip.frontLeft: Probe the front-left corner: X then Y face, from over the part.
cornerTip.frontRight: Probe the front-right corner: X then Y face, from over the part.
cornerTip.backLeft: Probe the back-left corner: X then Y face, from over the part.
cornerTip.backRight: Probe the back-right corner: X then Y face, from over the part.

cornerDone.frontLeft: {wcs} X0 Y0 set at the {corner} front-left corner.
cornerDone.frontRight: {wcs} X0 Y0 set at the {corner} front-right corner.
cornerDone.backLeft: {wcs} X0 Y0 set at the {corner} back-left corner.
cornerDone.backRight: {wcs} X0 Y0 set at the {corner} back-right corner.

materialProbe.insideCornerDone: {wcs} X0 Y0 set at the {corner} inside corner.
materialProbe.angleFrontBusy: Probing the front edge at two points…
materialProbe.angleLeftBusy: Probing the left edge at two points…
materialProbe.angleFrontDone: Front edge turns {degrees} ({rise} mm over {spacing} mm).
materialProbe.angleLeftDone: Left edge turns {degrees} ({rise} mm over {spacing} mm).
materialProbe.ballBusy: Probing both sides of the gauge…
materialProbe.boreDone: {wcs} X0 Y0 set at the bore centre, Ø {diameter} mm.
materialProbe.bossDone: {wcs} X0 Y0 set at the boss centre, Ø {diameter} mm.
materialProbe.ballDone: T{tool} ball Ø{diameter} mm saved to the tool table.
materialProbe.noRotation: The machine did not confirm the rotation.
materialProbe.noAngle: The machine did not report the edge angle.
materialProbe.noOrigin: The machine did not confirm the work origin.
materialProbe.noBall: The machine did not confirm the ball diameter.
materialProbe.noWidth: The machine did not report the measured width.
materialProbe.calibrateTip: Measure the ball on a gauge of known width: probe Z top on the gauge, jog the ball over its middle, then enter the width.
materialProbe.rotationEffect: Rotate the {wcs} XY axes {degrees} about its stored origin.
materialProbe.shiftStays: The current G52/G92 shift stays active.

guide.setupZTop: Touch off the probe at the setter and apply its length. Jog directly above the top surface.
guide.setupLeft: Jog beside the left edge, with the ball below the top and aligned with the face.
guide.setupRight: Jog beside the right edge, with the ball below the top and aligned with the face.
guide.setupFront: Jog beside the front edge, with the ball below the top and aligned with the face.
guide.setupBack: Jog beside the back edge, with the ball below the top and aligned with the face.
guide.setupCorner: Set Z0 on top first. Jog over the part, with the ball inside and within {reach} mm of both selected edges.
guide.setupRidge: Set Z0 on the ridge top first. Jog above the middle and enter the approximate width across the selected axis.
guide.setupInsideCorner: Jog the ball inside the recess, below the top and near the selected corner. Both walls must be within search travel.
guide.setupPocket: Jog the ball inside the pocket, below the top and roughly centred. Leave enough room for the ball to reach both walls on each measured axis.
guide.setupSlot: Jog the ball inside the slot, below the top and roughly centred. Leave enough room for the ball to reach both walls on each measured axis.
guide.setupBore: Jog the ball inside the bore below its top. Leave room to touch both X walls and both Y walls within the search travel.
guide.setupBoss: Set Z0 on the boss top first. Jog above the middle and enter its approximate diameter.
guide.setupBall: Set Z0 on the gauge top first. Jog above the middle of a gauge with parallel X faces and enter its known width.
guide.setupAngleFront: Jog beside the front edge with the ball below the top. Leave room for two touches along {axis} on the same straight face.
guide.setupAngleLeft: Jog beside the left edge with the ball below the top. Leave room for two touches along {axis} on the same straight face.
guide.setupTeach: Jog the loaded reference tool or a tool with a valid length directly above the centre of the setter.
guide.setupMeasure: Jog the tool directly above the centre of the taught setter.
guide.resultZTop: Set Z0 on the top surface
guide.resultCorner: Set X0 and Y0 at the corner
guide.resultInsideCorner: Set X0 and Y0 at the inside corner
guide.resultPocket: Set X0 and Y0 at the centre and report both widths
guide.resultWidth: Set {axis} at the centre and report the width
guide.resultDiameter: Set X0 and Y0 at the centre and report the diameter
guide.resultBall: Save the measured ball diameter to the tool table
guide.resultAngle: Report the angle. Rotation is applied in a separate confirmation.
guide.resultTeach: Record the setter height and position
guide.resultCheck: Compare the measured length with the tool table
guide.exampleCentre: X0 and Y0 at centre · example Ø{diameter} mm
guide.stepNext: Move to the next search position

guideCanvas.label: 3D probe motion: drag to rotate
guideCanvas.unavailable: 3D preview unavailable. Follow the jog and cycle instructions.

diagram.label: Workpiece viewed from above. The arrows point toward the edge as the probe moves.

workOffset.connectionChanged: The connection changed. Reopen this editor.
workOffset.originsChanged: These origins changed. Reopen this editor to use their current values.
workOffset.destinationChanged: The destination origins changed. Go back and review them again.
workOffset.replaces: Replaces {wcs} XYZ origins in machine coordinates. The machine does not move. XY rotation and G92/G52 shifts stay unchanged.
workOffset.active: {wcs} is active; the work readout changes immediately.
workOffset.title: {wcs} work origins
workOffset.unknown: Current origins are unavailable. Enter all three values to replace them, or close and select this system to read it first.

history.gone: This entry is no longer in the history.
history.effectTool: Writes the earlier {target} values back to the tool table (G10 L1). An applied length changes at the next G43.
history.effectShift: Writes the earlier G92/G52 shift back (G52). It is added to every work system.
history.effectWork: Writes the earlier {target} values back (G10 L2). Other axes stay unchanged.
history.title: Offset history
history.noHistory: The machine has not sent an offset history.
